finish_subtask.description: Finishes the currently active child JIN subtask.
schema: {"subtask_agent_id":"authoritative-id","session_id":"authoritative-session-id","original_conditions":"Original conditions","finish_reason":"What was completed and where the results are"}
rules: Use this only when the assigned child subtask is actually complete. The runtime validates authoritative IDs and overwrites original_conditions with the stored assignment. A report is not proof that a claimed file exists.
